# Heater core and A/C problems

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove components to detach the heater core and unattach the A/C hoses from the engine side of the firewall. [t1485]

[Partial] Recover refrigerant and remove the front grill to access the condenser area. [t1521]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the glove box.
2. Take off the center console, steering column plastic trim, radio heater controls, and the radio itself.
3. Detach two metal brackets located behind the removed plastic trim pieces.
4. Loosen the radiator antifreeze cap to prevent spills when unattaching the A/C hoses from the engine side of the firewall.
5. Unattach the A/C hoses from the engine side of the firewall.
6. Remove the black box containing the AC unit.
7. [Partial] Take out the center black heater core assembly.

_Procedure reported by [t1485]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/diy-replace-heater-core.731/>_

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1521] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Recover the refrigerant from the system using a shop or rental pump.
2. Remove the front grill to access the receiver/dryer and condenser area.

</details>

## Tools

- Vacuum pump [t1521]
- Manifold gauge set [t1521]

## Parts

- [Partial] Aluminum hose/tube, condenser to firewall [t1521]
- [Partial] Heater core assembly: Includes hard plastic tubes connecting to the firewall [t1485]
- Receiver/Dryer [t1521]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Ensure a heater core bypass is installed before starting. [t1485]
- [Partial] Loosen the radiator antifreeze cap slightly before disconnecting A/C hoses. [t1485]
- [Partial] Replace the receiver/dryer anytime the system is opened. [t1521]
